messages:
alex_chung: Kicking off bring-up for eu-north1 GPU cluster + registry warm-up. Goal: avoid cold-start token spikes for hosted inference. Plan is pre-pull the main inference image set and prime KV caches. Anyone able to help validate the pipeline?

mira_k: i'm around. are we doing a DaemonSet pre-pull or relying on regional registry cache + node prefetch?

alex_chung: leaning toward DaemonSet-based pre-pull for the first day (quick to roll back). Then switch to registry-side caching once replication stabilizes. rough plan: 1) ensure registry replication to registry-eu-north1 is 100% for model images 2) deploy prepull DaemonSet with `crane` 3) run smoke load to confirm steady-state memory/kv metrics.

infra-bot: image-replication-check: currently 94% replicated to registry-eu-north1. Missing: rwi-infer:2026-04-12, rwi-embed:2026-04-11. See https://registry.ops/redwood/replication/1801234567

samuel_r: heads up on cost — initial fanout from us-west will generate cross-region egress. Estimate ~1.8TB for full image set => ~$220 egress. We should stagger replication windows to avoid burst charges and throttle concurrency.

jordan_ops: for GitOps, we'll add a values override in the region overlay: `image.registry: registry-eu-north1.redwood.internal` and set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` + `imagePullSecrets` configured to use short-lived replication tokens. Also add an annotation for prepull DaemonSet so Argo ignores it for sync waves.

alex_chung: snippet for the pre-pull DaemonSet (apply from cluster-admin):
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: prepull-infer-images
  namespace: infra-prepull
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: prepull-infer-images
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: prepull-infer-images
    spec:
      tolerations: [{ key: "node.kubernetes.io/not-ready", operator: "Exists", effect: "NoExecute" }]
      containers:
      - name: crane-prepull
        image: ghcr.io/google/go-containerregistry/crane:latest
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c"]
        args: ["crane pull registry-eu-north1.redwood.internal/rwi-infer:2026-04-12 || exit 0"]
        resources: { requests: { cpu: \"100m\", memory: \"200Mi\" } }
```

mira_k: nice. add `nodeSelector: {gpu: \"true\"}` so we only pre-pull onto GPU nodes. we don't want to fill small infra nodes. Also set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.

ops-bot: registry-sync: replication job created (job-id: regsync-1801234575). ETA ~18m. Estimated egress: 1.8TB.

samuel_r: to reduce egress, run a two-stage plan: stage 1 = essential runtime images (rwi-infer + runtime base) immediately, stage 2 = model checkpoints and older tags over 48h with low concurrency. Will cut instant egress by ~60%.

alex_chung: agreed. i'll update the replication manifest to include label `priority: hot` for critical tags and `priority: cold` for big checkpoints. ArgoCD will sync the hot overlay first.

jordan_ops: reminder for CI/GitOps: add a validation job in the region overlay that runs `kubectl rollout status deployment/rwi-service -n inference` and then a quick smoke: `curl -sS --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${TEST_TOKEN}' https://eu-north1.api.redwood.dev/v1/generate | jq -r .status` — fail the sync if response != 200.

mira_k: monitoring checklist before handoff: 1) node GPU memory pressure dashboard 2) prefix/KV hit-rate dashboard 3) registry replication lag metric < 5m 4) node prepull success >= 95% 5) cost alert for egress > $300 over 24h. I created dashboards in observability and shared in #eng-oncall.

infra-bot: smoke-run: started test-run-1801234588 (100 qps for 5m).

alex_chung: running smoke now. if we see KV miss + high latency, we'll pause rollout and switch to fallback smaller model variant in routing policy.

samuel_r: FYI after first 10m: egress smoothing worked — current outbound is ~120MB/s instead of spike. replication lag down to 2m.

jordan_ops: pushed the helm region overlay changes to `gitops/overlays/eu-north1/values.yaml` and triggered Argo sync with `--prune=false` to avoid accidental deletes.

mira_k: smoke looks green, pre-pull success 98% on GPU nodes. handing to oncall for 24h watch. cc @oncall-team :white_check_mark:

alex_chung: thanks everyone. next steps: monitor cost alerts, let infra-bot post final replication summary in 24h, and then migrate pre-pull to registry-side caching once steady. :rocket:
